name: Lady Ada Lovelace
description: Known for pioneering work on Charles Babbage's Analytical Engine and often regarded as the first computer programmer.

name: Dr. Nikola Tesla
description: Recently patented a new wireless energy transmission system. Passionate about pigeons.

name: Grace Hopper
description: Invented one of the first linkers and contributed to COBOL. Good topics: compilers, debugging, and naval history.
